verdict.rationale: Docs show relevant building blocks — subagents that perform 'extensive codebase searches' (docs-18), Projects that give agents 'all of the context required for your codebase' across multiple folders/repos (docs-17, docs-35), a context-aware editor with natural-language commands (docs-6), and Artifacts that can include architecture diagrams (docs-30) — which together support exploring and reasoning about a codebase's structure. However there is no dedicated 'explain this codebase' or repo-map/navigation feature explicitly documented, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming this specific use case works well. Missing for 10: a first-class codebase-mapping/explanation feature, and community/hands-on validation that the agent's codebase search actually helps developers find where to start.
